TOUR OUR VILLAS
Into Wild Africa Luxury Safari Lodge — Central Serengeti
Extra-Large Luxury Safari Villas in Serengeti National Park
Experience the Serengeti in comfort and style in our brand-new, custom-built extra-large luxury safari villas, designed for the 2026 season. Each villa combines an authentic safari atmosphere with all the modern comforts of home.
Inside Your Luxury Safari Villa
New extra-comfort king-size beds for a restful night after your game drives
Spacious sitting area for relaxing, reading, or enjoying a drink
24-hour high-pressure hot and cold running water
En-suite bathroom with flush toilet and double sinks
Extra-large toilet and shower area with grab bars and wheelchair accessibility
Complimentary quality shampoo, shower gel, and moisturizing cream
Accessible Design
Accessible ramps leading to each villa for easy wheelchair and stroller access
Wide doorways and level thresholds to support guests with limited mobility
Grab bars in the toilet and shower area for additional safety and comfort
Outdoor Space & Views
Wrap-around patio and sitting area
Ideal for game viewing, relaxing, and sunset views after a day on safari in Serengeti National Park
Connectivity & Convenience
Unlimited internet access (available in every luxury safari villa, the dining area, and the bar area)*
Two-way radio in each villa for 24-hour service
Universal power outlets for easy charging of all your devices
Please note: As we are located inside Serengeti National Park , internet may occasionally be slow or temporarily unavailable due to our remote wilderness location.
Into Wild Africa Luxury Safari Lodge Location
Hidden deep in the central Serengeti National Park, along the Nyabogati River, Into Wild Africa Luxury Safari Lodge offers one of the best locations for a safari lodge. We are perfectly located 8km deep in the bush away from any road and on the edge of a beautiful Savannah plain. The river provides year round water for the animals, the bush great protection and of course exciting action on the plain. Your Into Wild Africa Safari Lodge experience will be like no other, you’ll be submerged in the wild for a truly unforgettable experience
in a nature inspired location and being only 23km from the Seronera airstrip our location has all the essentials!
INTO WILD AFRICA LUXURY SAFARI LODGE SERENGETI LOUNGE AND BAR
Relax and enjoy a cold drink after your long day on safari in Into Wild Africa's Bar and lounge.
You can watch the wild animals on the savanna through our spotting scope or sit and play one of our many board, chess, card or children's games.
Into Wild Africa Luxury Safari Lodge stocks all your favourite Beer, Wines and Spirits. Enjoy popcorn, peanuts and other snacks before moving to the dinning room.
Inside you will also find a USB charging station for all you phone and camera needs along with several universal power outlets.
Unlimited internet is also complimentary!
(please note this is Serengeti National Park and some times internet does go out or can be slow)

Welcome to Into Wild Africa Luxury Lodge & Villas Serengeti!
Welcome to Into Wild Africa Luxury Lodge & Villas Serengeti
Nestled in the heart of Tanzania's iconic Serengeti National Park, Into Wild Africa Luxury Lodge & Villas offers an extraordinary blend of refined comfort, authentic wilderness, and world-class hospitality. Designed for discerning travellers seeking an exclusive African safari experience, our luxury lodge and private villas provide the perfect gateway to one of the world's most celebrated wildlife destinations.
Surrounded by breathtaking savannah landscapes and abundant wildlife, Into Wild Africa delivers an intimate Serengeti luxury safari experience where nature and elegance exist in perfect harmony. Our beautifully appointed villas and lodge suites feature spacious interiors, private outdoor living areas, premium amenities, and panoramic views that immerse guests in the beauty of the African wilderness.
A highlight of the property is our spectacular swimming pool overlooking the Serengeti landscape , offering guests the perfect place to relax between safari adventures. Whether enjoying a refreshing swim after a morning game drive, unwinding poolside with a cocktail at sunset, or simply taking in the sweeping views of the African savannah, the pool enhances every aspect of the luxury safari experience. As a premier Serengeti lodge with a swimming pool , Into Wild Africa combines adventure, relaxation, and exclusivity in one extraordinary destination.
As a premier luxury safari lodge in Tanzania , we offer unparalleled access to the Serengeti's famous wildlife encounters, including the Great Migration, Big Five safaris, and year-round game viewing. Guests can enjoy expertly guided safari adventures before returning to the comfort and tranquility of their private sanctuary.
For couples seeking romance, Into Wild Africa is an exceptional destination for honeymoon safaris in the Serengeti . Our secluded villas provide an intimate setting for unforgettable moments, complete with personalized experiences, private dining, and spectacular sunset views across the African plains.
Families, photographers, and adventure enthusiasts will find the lodge perfectly positioned for immersive safari experiences, cultural encounters, and exploration of the Serengeti's most remarkable landscapes. Every stay is thoughtfully curated to combine adventure, relaxation, and authentic African hospitality.
Our commitment to sustainable tourism and responsible conservation ensures that guests can enjoy a luxury safari while helping preserve the extraordinary ecosystems and wildlife that make the Serengeti world-famous. Through environmentally conscious operations and support for local communities, Into Wild Africa contributes to the long-term protection of this remarkable region.
From exceptional dining and personalized service to luxurious accommodations and unforgettable wildlife experiences, every detail is designed to create a truly memorable stay. Whether you're witnessing a lion hunt at dawn, enjoying a sundowner overlooking the plains, or stargazing from your private villa, every moment at Into Wild Africa captures the magic of Africa.
Experience the ultimate Serengeti luxury lodge and villa retreat —where exceptional wildlife encounters, elegant accommodations, a stunning swimming pool, and world-class hospitality come together to create an unforgettable Tanzania safari vacation.

Welcome to Signature Serengeti Luxury Tented Safari Camp!
Welcome to Signature Serengeti Luxury Tented Safari Camp
Nestled in the heart of Tanzania's world-famous Serengeti National Park, Signature Serengeti Luxury Tented Safari Camp offers an unforgettable blend of authentic wilderness, exceptional comfort, and personalized hospitality. As one of the premier luxury safari camps in the Serengeti , Signature Serengeti provides guests with a front-row seat to Africa's most spectacular wildlife experiences, including the legendary Great Migration and year-round Big Five game viewing.
Designed to deliver a truly immersive Serengeti luxury safari experience , our spacious tented suites combine elegant contemporary design with the timeless charm of classic African safari travel. Each luxury tent features premium furnishings, en-suite facilities, private outdoor spaces, and breathtaking views across the endless Serengeti plains, creating a seamless connection between comfort and nature.
A standout feature of the camp is our new swimming pool overlooking the Serengeti landscape , offering guests a refreshing oasis between safari adventures. Whether cooling off after a game drive, enjoying a relaxed afternoon under the African sun, or watching wildlife in the distance, the pool area provides an additional layer of luxury rarely found in a tented safari camp. Guests seeking a Serengeti safari camp with a swimming pool will find the perfect combination of relaxation and wilderness at Signature Serengeti.
